fields.name: source
fields.label: Data address
fields.description: Where the data comes from: the current AEM feed (e.g. /bin/modal/v1/airportinformation.json?en-th or /bin/modal/thaiworldwideOfficesv1.json?en-th) or a published sheet (e.g. /en-th/data/airports.json). The format is detected automatically.

fields.name: defaultLocation
fields.label: Default location
fields.description: Shown first. Airports: an airport or country code, e.g. BKK. Offices: a country code or a city name, e.g. TH or BANGKOK (Suvarnabhumi).

fields.name: labels
fields.label: Labels
fields.description: Separated by |. Airports: picker title | location field, e.g. Select location | City / Country. Offices: picker title | country | city | office, e.g. Select location | Country / Region | City | Office.
